effects.label: Action
effects.text: Move one card from your Graveyard to your Discard Pile.

effects.label: Battle
effects.text: When revealed, apply the Battle effect of one card in your Graveyard that can apply now. Leave that card in your Graveyard.

effects.label: Action
effects.text: Bank this card.

effects.label: Activate
effects.text: In the Aftermath of a battle you initiated and won on a Territory the opponent controls, you may put this card in your Graveyard to advance your Front Line by one Territory, if able, instead of occupying it.

effects.label: Battle
effects.text: In the Aftermath, if you win as the attacker on a Territory the opponent controls, advance your Front Line by one Territory, if able, instead of occupying it. Put this card in your Graveyard after the Front Line advance.

effects.label: Action
effects.text: Place this card face up on the nearest enemy-controlled Territory ahead of you with an active printed effect. While it remains there, that printed Territory effect is inactive. The next time you attack there, put this card in its owner's Graveyard if you lose. If you win, or if you capture the Territory without a battle, turn this card face down; it becomes a Ruins Overlay.

effects.label: Battle
effects.text: If you are attacking on an enemy-controlled Territory, place this card face up on it. That Territory's printed effect is inactive during this battle. In the Aftermath, if you win, turn this card face down; it becomes a Ruins Overlay.

effects.label: Action
effects.text: Draw one card. You may immediately play one card from your Hand whose Action effect banks it without spending another Action.

effects.label: Gambit
effects.text: When Gambits are revealed, form your Reserve with one additional card. You may choose an additional Tactic during this battle.

effects.label: Action
effects.text: Return one card from your Discard Pile to your Hand.

effects.label: Battle
effects.text: When revealed, choose one eligible card in your Discard Pile whose Battle effect can apply now. Put this card in your Graveyard and place the chosen card face up in the same role. In the Aftermath, put the chosen card in your Graveyard unless its text says otherwise.

effects.label: Action
effects.text: Bank this card.

effects.label: Asset
effects.text: Opposing effects cannot reveal your Hand, Reserve, or face-down Gambits or Tactics. This does not prevent reveals required by the rules.

effects.label: Battle
effects.text: If an opposing effect would reveal this card or another face-down Gambit or Tactic you control at this card's reveal stage before the normal reveal, reveal this card and prevent that entire effect. Add +1 to your battle total.

effects.label: Action
effects.text: Bank this card.

effects.label: Activate
effects.text: When an opposing effect would place an Overlay on a Territory, you may discard this card to prevent that Overlay. If a card would have become it, put that card in its owner's Discard Pile.

effects.label: Battle
effects.text: Choose one: one Overlay on the contested Territory is inactive during this battle; or the next opposing Overlay that would be placed there during this battle or its Aftermath is not placed. If a card would have become it, put that card in its owner's Discard Pile.

effects.label: Action
effects.text: Bank this card.

effects.label: Activate
effects.text: In the Aftermath of a battle an opponent lost against you, after their normal retreat, you may discard this card to make them retreat one additional position, if able.

effects.label: Battle
effects.text: The opponent gains disadvantage during this battle. If they lose, after their normal retreat they retreat one additional position, if able.

effects.label: Action
effects.text: Bank this card.

effects.label: Activate
effects.text: If an opposing effect would cause one or more of your other Assets to leave play, you may discard this card to choose one affected Asset; it remains in play.

effects.label: Battle
effects.text: An opposing effect that would negate or remove a card you have in battle must choose this card before another eligible card you control, if able.

effects.label: Action
effects.text: Bank this card.

effects.label: Activate
effects.text: After you win while defending against a Counterattack, you may discard this card to draw two cards.

effects.label: Battle
effects.text: If you are defending against a Counterattack, gain advantage. In the Aftermath, if you won, draw one card.

effects.label: Action
effects.text: Place this card as an Overlay on any Territory that does not already have a Landslide.

effects.label: Battle
effects.text: In the Aftermath, if you lose and retreat from a Territory, after retreating you may place this card as an Overlay on the contested Territory.

effects.label: Overlay
effects.text: When a player retreats onto this Territory, they retreat one additional Position, if able. Then put this card in its owner's Discard Pile.

effects.label: Action
effects.text: As an additional cost, put every other card in your Hand in your Graveyard. Then put banked Assets you control in your Graveyard until you have put at least three cards there this way, including at least one Asset. Add this card to your end of the Gauntlet. It becomes a blank Territory under your control.

effects.label: Battle
effects.text: In the Aftermath, if you win as the attacker and inserting this card between the contested Territory and the Position from which you attacked would place it immediately beyond your Front Line, insert it there. It becomes a blank Territory under your control.

effects.label: Action
effects.text: Bank this card.

effects.label: Activate
effects.text: During Onset while you are the defender, you may discard this card to make the opponent's banked Assets inactive during that battle.

effects.label: Battle
effects.text: When revealed, before other effects at this stage, if you are the defender, negate one opposing Gambit whose effect has not been applied. If there is no eligible Gambit, gain advantage instead.

effects.label: Action
effects.text: Bank this card.

effects.label: Asset
effects.text: When the opponent would capture a Territory you control, put this card in your Graveyard to prevent that capture.

effects.label: Battle
effects.text: In the Aftermath, if you lose while defending a Territory you control, place this card there as an Overlay.

effects.label: Overlay
effects.text: When the opponent would capture this Territory, prevent that capture, then put this card in your Graveyard. If the opposing Player Token leaves first, put this card in your Graveyard.

effects.label: Action
effects.text: Bank this card.

effects.label: Activate
effects.text: When an opposing effect puts one or more of your other cards in your Discard Pile, you may discard this card to return one of those cards to your Hand after the effect applies.

effects.label: Battle
effects.text: If an opposing effect negates one other Tactic you chose and that card would enter your Discard Pile, return it to your Hand in the Aftermath instead.

effects.label: Action
effects.text: Bank this card.

effects.label: Activate
effects.text: During Opening or Denouement, you may discard this card to take one additional Action during that phase.

effects.label: Battle
effects.text: After Tactics are revealed, draw one additional card into your Reserve. You may play it face up as an additional Tactic.

effects.label: Action
effects.text: Discard one banked Asset you control to draw two cards.

effects.label: Battle
effects.text: You may discard one banked Asset you control to gain advantage.

effects.label: Action
effects.text: Return one card from your Discard Pile to your Hand, then discard one card from your Hand.

effects.label: Battle
effects.text: In the Aftermath, if you won, you may put one card remaining in your Reserve in your Hand instead of your Discard Pile, then discard one card from your Hand.

effects.label: Action
effects.text: Bank this card.

effects.label: Activate
effects.text: In the Aftermath of a battle you lost while defending a Territory you control, after you retreat, you may place this card on that Territory as a Ruins Overlay.

effects.label: Battle
effects.text: In the Aftermath, if you lose while defending a Territory you control and retreat, place this card on that Territory as a Ruins Overlay.

effects.label: Action
effects.text: Reveal the top card of either Draw Pile or one random card from the opponent's Hand.

effects.label: Battle
effects.text: When revealed, before other effects at this stage, reveal one opposing face-down Gambit or Tactic at the same stage. You may replace this card with an eligible card from your Reserve, face up. If you replace it, put this card in your Graveyard.

effects.label: Action
effects.text: Bank this card.

effects.label: Activate
effects.text: When an opposing card effect would move you, you may discard this card to ignore that movement.

effects.label: Battle
effects.text: If you are the defender, gain advantage.

effects.label: Action
effects.text: Return one banked Asset you control to your Hand to gain one additional Position of movement this turn. If you play this during Denouement after your normal Movement has ended, begin a new Movement sequence with up to one Position of movement.

effects.label: Battle
effects.text: In the Aftermath, if you lose, after your normal retreat you may move one additional position toward your own end and return one other card you controlled in this battle to your Hand.

effects.label: Action
effects.text: Bank this card.

effects.label: Activate
effects.text: After your normal Draw step, you may discard this card to draw two cards.

effects.label: Battle
effects.text: In the Aftermath, draw two cards, then discard one card.

effects.label: Action
effects.text: Draw two cards, then place one card from your Hand on the bottom of your Draw Pile.

effects.label: Gambit
effects.text: When Gambits are revealed, form your Reserve with one additional card. This does not increase the number of Tactics you may choose.
